methods.label: Factor the repeated expression
methods.explanation: Moving terms gives \((x-2)²-3(x-2)=0\). Factoring out the common factor gives \((x-2)(x-2-3)=0\), or \((x-2)(x-5)=0\), so \(x=2\) or \(x=5\). Dividing both sides by \(x-2\) would lose the root \(x=2\).
